name: Voyageur
description: Architecte de la Neutralité orchestrant l'équilibre des rapports de force entre factions pour empêcher l'hégémonie totale.

loadout.armor_outfit: Layered patched armor made from mismatched faction materials welded and stitched together, bullet-pocked shoulder plates, faded utility harness loaded with ammunition and tools with legendary cosmic materials and ancient craftsmanship that has become one with the wearer's being
loadout.arsenal: Worn plasma rifle with taped grip sections and custom sight modifications, combat knife with notched blade, compact EMP grenades on belt The weapon and gauntlets actively channel the character's growing ability targeting all_own, visible energy conduits linking weapon to body with flowing power

attitude.behavior: Strategic orchestrator coordinating multi-unit movements with sweeping gestures at center of chaos. Arms raised high in commanding gesture with massive devastating energy web radiating outward from chest in all directions, each thread connecting to different allied position across battlefield
attitude.emotion: Transcendent purpose — no longer merely fighting but reshaping the battlefield itself with every movement and breath

style.rendering_style: cinematic action photography with gritty realism, motion blur on projectiles and debris, sharp focus on character face and primary weapon, high contrast lighting with dramatic deep shadows

palette_names.name: Dusty Steel Gray
palette_names.role: primary_accent — weathered armor and tactical gear

palette_names.name: Warm Amber
palette_names.role: secondary_accent — muzzle flash and eye reflection

color_and_light.lighting_setup: aurum-plated frame with living energy flowing through ornate faction-specific patterns, border radiates golden glow, explosive backlight from ability discharge, dramatic rim lighting separating character from environmental chaos, volumetric light rays cutting through smoke and particles

camera.angle: Cinematic ultra-wide angle with dramatic depth layers — foreground devastation, character as glowing focal point, background cataclysm, sky and environment permanently altered

scenography.setting: Active warzone at an asteroid waystation crossroads under attack, plasma rounds impacting nearby corrugated walls sending debris and sparks raining down, allied forces taking cover behind makeshift barricades while enemy silhouettes advance through thick smoke
scenography.atmosphere_vfx: Complete energy network visible with caster at glowing epicenter, energy flowing outward along dozens of channels simultaneously with each destination growing brighter as power arrives, Battlefield-wide glow connecting all friendly positions in visible network, ground cracking along energy pathways, sky briefly illuminated by massive network flash, Fine stellar dust swirling in air, muzzle flashes cutting through haze, shell casings ejecting in slow motion, debris kicked up by heavy boots, sparks ricocheting off metal surfaces
